data.description:
## Description
**What**: Implement plugins/dso/scripts/intent-header-source-check.sh implementing the (a+) header-vs-source import check.
**Why**: Catches tests that claim an intent in their header but do not reference the intent's source files — a tautology-prone but cheap second signal that complements manifest-claim breadth.
**Scope**:
- IN: applies only to test files carrying an intent-claim header per d566 Rule 6 (header-less files skipped); per file: extract intent_id; resolve source_files via the manifest entry's source_files field, else the parent ticket's file_impact array, else emit source_files_unresolved (warn, fail-open, skip the check for that intent); when file_impact is used, additionally check disk presence and emit file_impact_likely_stale (warn) for missing entries while still matching against surviving entries; parse the test file with sg (ast-grep); emit header_source_mismatch when the test references no source_files entry; --output-file ARG_MAX-safe findings output; validate emitted findings against the sc-1 schema.
- OUT: per-language dynamic-import fail-open detection (sc-6); manifest-claim breadth check (sc-2); multi-surface wiring (sc-4); e2e fixtures (sc-5).

## Done Definitions

- intent-header-source-check.sh skips test files without an intent-claim header and, for a headered test file whose content references no source_files entry, emits header_source_mismatch validating against the sc-1 schema ← Satisfies: sc-3
- When an intent has no manifest source_files field and an empty parent file_impact, the script emits source_files_unresolved (warn) and skips the (a+) check for that intent ← Satisfies: sc-3
- When source_files are resolved from file_impact and a referenced path is absent on disk, the script emits file_impact_likely_stale (warn) and still matches against the surviving file_impact entries ← Satisfies: sc-3
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic ← Satisfies: sc-3

## Considerations

- [Dependency] External blocker d566-afa6-1aa3-4293 (Rule 6 intent-claim header): the script parses the header format d566 defines; cross-epic dependency.
- [Dependency] External blocker 94ed-f55c-51f5-45f6: source_files resolution prefers the manifest entry's source_files field.
- [Build] intent-header-source-check.sh is a new .sh file and must have its executable bit set per CLAUDE.md.
- [Reliability] When sg is absent or has no parser for the test language the script emits dynamic_import_inconclusive (warn, fail-open) and runs no grep fallback, because grep fallback produces false positives.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO maintainer, I want a header-vs-source import check, so that a test claiming an intent but referencing none of the intent's source files is surfaced as a mismatch.
